As the wind howled outside, Thomas hummed the quiet tune, startled to realize its rhythm matched the steady sweep of his own rotating light across the dark.", "w02": "凌晨四点，整座城市沉入一天中最寂静的梦乡。白日喧嚣的柏油路泛着微凉的潮气，昏黄的路灯将行道树的枝桠拉出斑驳长影。环卫工人的扫帚与地面沙沙作响，早点铺升腾起第一缕温热的白烟。远处高楼间零星亮着几扇温暖的窗，照亮了夜归人与早行人交错的匆忙脚步。", "w03": "- It is like holding two mirrors facing each other and seeing smaller and smaller reflections of yourself continuing inside.\n- In code, it means solving a big problem by having a rule call itself to solve a smaller piece of that same problem.\n- Most importantly, it always needs a stopping point, like opening Russian nesting dolls until you finally reach the solid tiny doll inside."}
